_description: Hand-authored (NOT nnU-Net-planner-generated) 'much bigger' variant of voxtell_scratch_96/plans.json: same 96^3 patch size and stage/stride schedule (an extra non-downsampling stage after the stem, same as voxtell_scratch_96), but features_per_stage widened from [32,64,128,256,320,320] to [64,128,256,512,512,512] (nnU-Net-L's 320 channel cap raised to 512) and n_blocks_per_stage scaled up further from [1,2,6,8,10,10] to [2,4,10,14,18,18]. Widening features_per_stage means this config's real per-stage (channels, shape) pairs no longer match VoxTellModel.DECODER_CONFIGS' hardcoded table (an external-package class attribute, not derived from arch_kwargs) at any index -- decoder_configs.json (sibling file, this same directory) is a full REPLACEMENT table matching this architecture instead, monkey-patched onto VoxTellModel by build_voxtell_model when it finds this file present. decoder_layer=4/num_maskformer_stages=5 select into that replacement table, not the original -- see decoder_configs.json's own values. This config also expects --text-embedding-dim 4096 (Qwen3-Embedding-8B's hidden_size) rather than voxtell_scratch_96's 2560 (Qwen3-Embedding-4B) -- unrelated to arch_kwargs/DECODER_CONFIGS, passed as its own finetune_voxtell.py flag.
